content.comment_body: I'm experiencing an issue with the connection lines between blocks. In a large project using [product_name] versions [version_no] with nearly 200 blocks, after testing, most of the black lines remain blue or red when switching back to program mode. This makes it difficult to tell if you're in monitor or program mode. More lines keep changing colors until there are no black lines left. Even saving and reopening the project doesn't fix the problem. Is there a way to restore the lines to black?
Hello, Try upgrading the software to the latest version [version_no]. You can use the Help/Update center or download updates from [url]. Hope this helps.
Alternatively, you can install the latest version of JAWA (update available).

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing a recurring problem where connection lines in complex projects do not revert to their standard black color after exiting monitoring mode, which affects readability and makes working with large projects more challenging. Attempts to reset the lines by saving or reopening the project have not been successful.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects connection lines to return to their original black color after leaving monitor mode to ensure clear differentiation and maintain workspace clarity.
